title: python/README.md:76 SCHC row stale: '60+ bytes to ~10 bytes' vs normative 52->23/37 (Rule 0/1)
description: Found during edge-cases codereview pass of 7gfj (delegated to kimi-k3). python/README.md feature table SCHC row says 'IPv6+UDP+CoAP compression from 60+ bytes to ~10 bytes'. Both figures are wrong: uncompressed base is 52 bytes and no rule compresses below 21 bytes (minimum Rule 7 link-local residue), normative compressed figures are 23 bytes (Rule 0 link-local) or 37 bytes (Rule 1 Yggdrasil) per spec/03-adaptation.md 5.3. Stale on origin/main too (verified). Fix: reword the SCHC row to '52 bytes of headers to 23 bytes (link-local) / 37 bytes (Yggdrasil)' or equivalent normative phrasing. Also sweep python/README.md for other stale compression figures while there. Discovered-from project-LICHEN-worker6-7gfj.
